# proxmox_cluster_ceph_restart_bulk (Resource)

Restarts outdated Ceph daemons cluster-wide through `POST /cluster/ceph/restart-bulk`. PVE 9.2 returns 501 for this path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_ceph_restart_bulk" "outdated" {
  service_type  = "osd"
  only_outdated = true
  triggers      = { run = "2026-11-04" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean)
- `only_outdated` (Boolean)
- `service_type` (String)
- `timeout` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
